action.prompt: 开始任务前，先读 docs/wiring.md 与对应接口文件（src/*/interfaces.py），确认输入输出契约；不要凭空改接口；改动后跑 python scripts/check_interfaces.py。

hooks.description: Agent hook: reminds the agent to re-read the wiring doc and the relevant interface files before starting a spec task, and to run the interface self-check after changes. Agent hooks start a new agent loop and consume credits, so this one ships disabled; enable it in the Kiro Agent Hooks panel when the budget allows.
hooks.name: Recheck the wiring contract before a spec task starts
